Code review
Plugins in the official community directory are automatically reviewed after every update.
Open source
Most plugins are open source on GitHub, so you can inspect the code yourself.
Peer audit
We have a large community of developers who watch out for each other.
Report mechanism
We follow up and remove faulty plugins upon user report.
Allow community plugins
Plugins can execute arbitrary code on your device. We recommend backing up your data before enabling them.
Exit Restricted mode
Learn more about plugin security
